svg.title: FairEO-Bench geographic cropland classifier performance map preview
svg.desc: Static preview based on the committed FairEO country-held-out LightGBM data. Countries are colored by measured classifier AUC when eligible; Kenya is highlighted as an example, with AUC 0.698, 95 percent bootstrap interval 0.679 to 0.721, and an exploratory trust estimate of 0.745. Click the image in the README for the live interactive map.

g.text: How does cropland accuracy vary by country?
Country-held-out benchmark · Gradient-boosted trees · 66 eligible countries
Preview from committed map data · Map is static here; open the live site to select countries and layers.
